assertions.detail: Not observed. No sub-agent invocation appears in any captured run: no Task/Agent tool_use and no subagent_type field in any of the four streams, and no .kinglet-probe/receipts/agent.json was written.

Discovered and called. The plugin's .mcp.json server registered on install; the client resolved the tool name mcp__plugin_kinglet-client-probe_kinglet-client-probe__kinglet_probe_read_marker via ToolSearch, then called it with project_root set to the disposable project. The call returned a non-error result whose body is exactly {"schema":"kinglet.client-probe.receipt/v1","marker":"KINGLET_CLIENT_PROBE_PROJECT","unity_version":"6000.3.11f1"}, matching the on-disk marker file and ProjectSettings/ProjectVersion.txt.

A structured JSON receipt was written to disk by the client. In the isolation MCP run the client called Write and created .kinglet-probe/receipts/mcp-read.json containing valid JSON conforming to kinglet.client-probe.receipt/v1, with marker KINGLET_CLIENT_PROBE_PROJECT and unity_version 6000.3.11f1. The post-run listing confirms the file exists on disk with that content.

Half observed. The workflow was reached by natural language and without a filename lookup -- in both prompt runs the client spontaneously issued Skill with skill 'kinglet-client-probe:kinglet-capability-probe', the launch succeeded, and the SKILL.md body was injected into the session. But the workflow's defined receipt was never produced: .kinglet-probe/receipts/workflow.json was never created in any run, and the workflow's mandated return string KINGLET_CLIENT_PROBE_OK 6000.3.11f1 was never emitted.
